quest.title: Disco in Motion, Holiday Emotion!
quest.description: A courier from Natlan brings word inviting you and Paimon back to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort to take part in a one-of-a-kind "Dance Party"...

talks.objective: Go to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Something like this... and like that... Those little thieves will be on their knees crying for mercy...

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: At a moment like this, if you "accidentally" let one of them slip away, He'll panic and run back to report it — and you just quietly tail him...

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Then, right when they're busy planning their next move, you kick down the door to their hideout and give them the scare of a lifetime!

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: You make a very good point, Ms. Enghiene. When dealing with irredeemable criminals, unconventional methods are indeed necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: Natlan isn't like Fontaine, with all those convoluted... ahem, "elaborate law enforcement procedures"! I'll make good use of that advantage.

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: I already rounded up the remaining Saurian poachers earlier. I'll use your method and wipe out the smugglers to the north in one fell swoop.

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: And don't forget to give me the good news afterward. I'm really looking forward to it!

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: *sigh*... I'm no longer a member of the Maison Gardiennage. Under confidentiality regulations, Turenna can no longer report her work to me either.

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Feels like I still have a few tricks I haven't shared with the people who could use them... Maybe I should just write a memoir?

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Yes, a memoir sold exclusively to law enforcement all over the world! My 150 years of experience should be useful.

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: I'm all for it! Once you've fully enjoyed this party and feel nice and refreshed, writing it is sure to go smoothly too...

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: Then save me a signed copy!

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: You'll get the very first one! Once I've danced to my heart's content, I'll rent a typewriter as soon as I get back and start writing immediately!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that's an unexpected combination. What are they talking about?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Alright! Our lead dancer is here — the great Tumaini! Let the party begin!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: First things first — big news! Our second dance party is now underway!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: And we've got new participants too: Ms. Enghiene from the Fontaine tour group, along with her three companions!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Also, thanks to our "Uthabiti," Kachina, and the idol from Mondstadt, the Fontaine guests and the Ashas here have all learned brand-new dance moves!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, wait, wait... that's way too much information at once...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So besides everyone from before and the little Saurians, there are Melusines and... Ashas joining the stage too?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Exactly! Which means we get to dance to even more upbeat music and have even more fun!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: As the lead dancer, you'll also get to show how well you can adapt to any rhythm!

choices.text: The greater the hype, the better the vibe!

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: #Hold on, Nusta called you "Tumaini"... So you're THE Tumaini, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: The young warrior of the Children of Echoes who taught me to dance said her master is the great Tumaini of Natlan — and an amazing dancer too...

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: So after all that roundabout talk... it was you!

choices.text: Then that makes me your grand-master, doesn't it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pfft... guess Paimon's a grand-master too, then.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: No way, no way! Why do I suddenly feel like I just dropped two ranks...?

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Let's just each do our own ranking, okay?

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Anyway, dancing really comes down to talent.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Who knows — maybe I'm one of those protagonist-level geniuses. Give me two days, and I'll be dancing just as well as you.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Not that we need to compete or anything. I just mean... whatever the beat, whatever the trendiest moves, I can always keep up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, right! Dancing's all about having fun! Even if all you can do is sway to the beat, you're still part of it!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Looks like everything's ready?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: If you want to catch up with friends first, they're all waiting for you over there!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Or we can gather everyone here anytime, get the music going, and kick off the main event!

choices.text: Guess the Special Patrol Officer's intel network has limits too, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Even an instructor like you slips up sometimes! How could you miss such important intel from a neighboring country?

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Hey now, that's not fair. I don't operate outside my jurisdiction. Why bother with things that don't concern me?

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Knowing too much can mess with your head, you know? It's all about managing your information load.

choices.text: Sounds like they're talking about something pretty dangerous...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Natlan's couriers have left us a message at the Adventurers' Guild. It says that the People of the Springs, Children of Echoes, and the Flower-Feather Clan are organizing a party at Easybreeze Holiday Resort.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds kinda familiar... Seems like it should be super fun! Let's look into it when we have time!
